title: Rahu - Ketu Transit - Dec 5, 2026
content:
1. Mesh / Aries

5th House · Creativity, Children & Romance

Mars–Ketu may bring impulsive decisions in love, creative projects and speculation. Avoid unnecessary arguments with children and take a disciplined approach to investments. Focus on learning, spiritual practices and thoughtful creative expression rather than acting on sudden excitement.

2. Vrishabh / Taurus

4th House · Home, Property & Peace

Domestic responsibilities or property matters may require extra patience. Avoid heated family discussions and rushing into repairs or real-estate decisions. Make time for emotional balance and check vehicle or household maintenance carefully.

3. Mithun / Gemini

3rd House · Courage, Communication & Effort

This transit may intensify courage and the urge to take initiative. However, sharp speech, impulsive travel and disagreements with siblings or colleagues could create friction. Channel your energy into focused work, skill development and carefully planned communication.

4. Kark / Cancer

2nd House · Finances, Speech & Family

Exercise caution with spending, family discussions and financial commitments. Impulsive purchases or harsh words may cause avoidable problems. Review your budget, communicate calmly and avoid making important money decisions under emotional pressure.

5. Simha / Leo

1st House · Self, Confidence & Decisions

The conjunction falls in your Moon-sign house, potentially increasing restlessness, impatience and the urge to assert yourself. Avoid ego clashes and rushed decisions. Prioritise measured leadership, adequate rest and careful attention to personal safety.

6. Kanya / Virgo

12th House · Expenses, Rest & Inner Life

Unplanned expenses, disturbed sleep or a desire for solitude may become more noticeable. Review spending and avoid unnecessary risks while travelling or working behind the scenes. Meditation, adequate rest and a structured routine can help you stay grounded.

7. Tula / Libra

11th House · Gains, Networks & Goals

Your ambitions and desire for results may intensify, but impulsive decisions involving friends, groups or financial gains need caution. Reassess long-term goals and avoid speculative shortcuts. Consistent effort and carefully chosen professional connections may prove more useful than quick wins.

8. Vrishchik / Scorpio

10th House · Career, Reputation & Authority

Work pressure and the urge to make decisive career moves may increase. Avoid confrontations with seniors and decisions driven by frustration. Review professional strategy carefully, maintain transparency and direct your energy towards measurable goals and responsible leadership.

9. Dhanu / Sagittarius

9th House · Fortune, Beliefs & Higher Learning

Differences over beliefs, mentors or long-term plans may require diplomacy. Avoid acting on rigid opinions or rushing into distant travel and educational commitments. Stay open to new perspectives and verify important information before making decisions.

10. Makar / Capricorn

8th House · Sudden Changes, Shared Resources & Research

Shared finances, insurance, taxes or confidential matters may need closer review. Avoid unnecessary risks and rushed commitments. This period can also encourage deeper research, self-reflection and spiritual study; handle sensitive matters methodically rather than fearfully.

11. Kumbh / Aquarius

7th House · Marriage, Partnerships & Business

Relationships and business partnerships may require extra patience. Avoid ultimatums, impulsive agreements and turning minor disagreements into major conflicts. Clear communication, realistic expectations and careful review of contracts can help preserve important partnerships.

12. Meen / Pisces

6th House · Work, Competition & Daily Routine

Workload or competition may feel more demanding, making discipline especially valuable. Avoid workplace disputes and careless handling of daily responsibilities. Maintain consistent routines, address practical problems early and do not neglect ordinary health and safety precautions.

title: Sun Transit: Libra to Scorpio | 16 November 2026
content:
On 16 November 2026, the Sun (Surya) moves from Libra (Tula) into Scorpio (Vrishchik). In Vedic astrology, the Sun represents authority, confidence, leadership, father, government, recognition, status and vitality.

These predictions are based on Moon sign (Chandra Rashi), considering Scorpio as the transit sign. Each sign's predictions are based on the house occupied by transiting Sun from its natal Moon sign.


1. Aries / Mesh (मेष) – 8th House

  1. Sudden developments may bring unexpected changes in personal and professional life.

  2. Be cautious while handling financial matters, loans, taxes and shared assets.

  3. Avoid unnecessary arguments with in-laws or your partner's family.

  4. Interest in occult sciences, astrology, spirituality and research may increase.

  5. Pay attention to your health and avoid taking unnecessary risks.


2. Taurus / Vrishabh (वृषभ) – 7th House

  1. Differences of opinion may arise with your spouse or romantic partner.

  2. Business partnerships may require extra patience and understanding.

  3. Avoid dominating others or imposing your decisions in relationships.

  4. Professional collaborations may bring important responsibilities.

  5. Maintain a balanced approach in marriage and business dealings.


3. Gemini / Mithun (मिथुन) – 6th House

  1. You may gain an advantage over competitors and workplace rivals.

  2. Pending debts, disputes or legal matters may start moving towards resolution.

  3. Career opportunities may improve through dedication and consistent efforts.

  4. Your ability to handle challenging situations may increase.

  5. Maintain discipline in your daily routine and pay attention to your health.


4. Cancer / Karka (कर्कट) – 5th House

  1. Students should remain focused on academics and competitive examinations.

  2. Avoid unnecessary arguments with children or younger family members.

  3. Romantic relationships may experience ego clashes or misunderstandings.

  4. Be cautious while making speculative investments or taking financial risks.

  5. Creative interests and intellectual activities may receive greater attention.


5. Leo / Simha (सिंহ) – 4th House

  1. Domestic responsibilities may increase during this period.

  2. Differences of opinion with your mother or family members are possible.

  3. Matters related to property, vehicles and real estate may require attention.

  4. Professional responsibilities may affect your personal and family time.

  5. Avoid making important decisions under emotional pressure.


6. Virgo / Kanya (कन्या) – 3rd House

  1. Your courage, confidence and willingness to take initiative may increase.

  2. Professional communication and networking may bring beneficial opportunities.

  3. Short-distance journeys may prove productive.

  4. You may receive support through siblings or close acquaintances.

  5. This is a favourable period to promote your ideas, skills and personal ventures.


7. Libra / Tula (तुला) – 2nd House

  1. Financial matters may require greater attention and careful planning.

  2. Avoid harsh or impulsive speech, particularly while communicating with family.

  3. Unexpected expenses may disturb your financial planning.

  4. Family responsibilities may demand more time and attention.

  5. Focus on savings and avoid unnecessary purchases.


8. Scorpio / Vrishchik (वृश्चिक) – 1st House

  1. Your confidence, determination and desire to take control may increase.

  2. You may become more assertive while expressing your opinions.

  3. Avoid ego clashes and unnecessary confrontations with others.

  4. Pay attention to your physical health, energy levels and daily routine.

  5. Professional life may demand greater personal involvement and accountability.


9. Sagittarius / Dhanu (धनु) – 12th House

  1. Unplanned expenses may increase, making financial discipline important.

  2. Opportunities related to foreign connections or distant places may arise.

  3. Sleep patterns and mental peace may require attention.

  4. You may feel inclined towards spirituality, meditation and isolation.

  5. Avoid unnecessary financial commitments and impulsive decisions.


10. Capricorn / Makar (मकर) – 11th House

  1. Financial gains and income opportunities may improve.

  2. Professional networking may help you connect with influential people.

  3. Support from senior professionals or authority figures may prove beneficial.

  4. Long-term ambitions may receive positive momentum.

  5. You may benefit from new associations, professional groups and social connections.


11. Aquarius / Kumbha (कुम्भ) – 10th House

  1. Career growth and professional recognition may become important themes.

  2. Opportunities to take leadership roles or additional responsibilities may arise.

  3. Your relationship with seniors and government authorities may require attention.

  4. Business owners may focus on expansion, reputation and professional visibility.

  5. Consistent efforts may bring recognition for your work and achievements.


12. Pisces / Meen (मीन) – 9th House

  1. Differences of opinion with your father, teachers or mentors are possible.

  2. You may experience changes in your beliefs, principles and spiritual outlook.

  3. Long-distance journeys may require additional planning.

  4. Higher education, research and professional learning may demand greater attention.

  5. Avoid overconfidence and remain respectful towards experienced individuals.

title: Mars in Leo | 12th November 2026
content:
1. Mesha Rashi (Aries):

Mars transits the 5th house

This transit may bring increased ambition, courage and determination in matters related to education, creativity and personal goals. Students may experience greater competitive drive, but impatience and lack of concentration could affect academic performance. Romantic relationships may experience sudden disagreements or emotional distance. Avoid impulsive decisions in speculative investments and matters involving children. This period can also encourage deeper interest in spirituality, mantra and traditional knowledge.

2. Vrishabha Rashi (Taurus):

Mars transits the 4th house

Domestic matters may become more demanding, with the possibility of disagreements within the family, particularly concerning property, assets or household responsibilities. There may be a strong desire to purchase a vehicle, renovate a home or make changes to living arrangements. However, avoid rushing into property-related decisions. Maintain patience with your mother and other family members. Emotional restlessness and disturbances in domestic peace may require attention.

3. Mithuna Rashi (Gemini):

Mars transits the 3rd house

This transit may increase courage, initiative and the willingness to take calculated risks. You may become more determined to pursue professional goals, independent projects and new opportunities. Communication could become unusually direct, creating misunderstandings with siblings, colleagues or neighbours. Short-distance travel and networking may increase. Channel your energy into productive activities and avoid unnecessary arguments or impulsive decisions.

4. Karka Rashi (Cancer):

Mars transits the 2nd house

Financial matters and family responsibilities may require additional attention. There could be unexpected expenses, disagreements over money or differences of opinion within the family. Your speech may become more aggressive or straightforward, potentially affecting personal relationships. Exercise caution while making financial commitments and avoid impulsive purchases. Pay attention to eating habits and maintain a balanced approach towards savings and expenditure.

5. Simha Rashi (Leo):

Mars transits the 1st house

This is an intense transit for Leo natives, as Mars, Ketu and Jupiter occupy your Moon sign. You may experience a strong desire to establish yourself, take charge and pursue ambitious goals. However, the conjunction of Mars and Ketu may create impatience, impulsive behaviour and uncertainty regarding personal direction. Relationships may experience ego clashes or sudden misunderstandings. Give importance to physical well-being, emotional balance and thoughtful decision-making. Spiritual inclination and interest in self-discovery may also increase.

6. Kanya Rashi (Virgo):

Mars transits the 12th house

Expenses may increase, particularly in connection with travel, healthcare, accommodation or personal responsibilities. Sleep patterns and mental peace may require attention. Some natives may explore foreign opportunities, relocation or professional assignments away from their usual environment. Avoid unnecessary financial commitments and be cautious about confidential matters. This transit can also encourage spiritual practices, meditation and introspection.

7. Tula Rashi (Libra):

Mars transits the 11th house

This transit may increase your ambitions and determination to achieve long-term financial and professional goals. New opportunities may emerge through professional networks, influential individuals and social connections. However, disagreements with friends, colleagues or elder siblings may arise due to differences in expectations. Be selective about partnerships and avoid allowing financial ambitions to influence important personal relationships. Focus on realistic goals rather than quick gains.

8. Vrishchika Rashi (Scorpio):

Mars transits the 10th house

Career and professional responsibilities may become a major focus during this transit. You may feel motivated to pursue leadership opportunities, take independent decisions or establish your professional identity. However, the Mars–Ketu combination may create sudden changes in professional priorities, disagreements with authority figures or dissatisfaction with existing responsibilities. Avoid impulsive career decisions and maintain professionalism during workplace conflicts. This period can be productive when ambition is channelled with discipline.

9. Dhanu Rashi (Sagittarius):

Mars transits the 9th house

Matters related to higher education, long-distance travel, religious beliefs and professional learning may become prominent. You may develop a stronger desire to explore new philosophies, pursue advanced studies or travel for personal and professional reasons. Differences of opinion with your father, teachers or mentors may arise. Avoid becoming rigid about your beliefs and exercise caution while undertaking long journeys. This period may also encourage deeper spiritual exploration.

10. Makara Rashi (Capricorn):

Mars transits the 8th house

This transit may bring greater attention to joint finances, investments, inheritance, taxes and other shared responsibilities. Unexpected developments may require you to reassess financial arrangements or existing commitments. Avoid taking unnecessary risks, engaging in speculative activities or making decisions without adequate information. Be cautious while handling machinery, sharp objects and physically demanding activities. This period can also encourage research, occult studies and deeper investigation into hidden subjects.

11. Kumbha Rashi (Aquarius):

Mars transits the 7th house

Relationships, marriage and business partnerships may require additional patience and understanding. Differences of opinion, ego clashes and impulsive reactions could create tension between partners. Those involved in business partnerships should maintain transparency in financial and professional dealings. Avoid making major relationship decisions in moments of anger. For unmarried natives, this period may bring intense relationship developments, but careful assessment of compatibility and intentions is important.

12. Meena Rashi (Pisces):

Mars transits the 6th house

This transit may strengthen your competitive spirit and determination to overcome professional challenges, workplace obstacles and existing disputes. You may become more proactive in handling debts, pending responsibilities and difficult situations. However, workplace disagreements and conflicts with colleagues should be handled diplomatically. Pay attention to health routines, stress management and physical safety. This can be a productive period for competitive examinations, resolving disputes and addressing long-standing responsibilities.
